Australia names playing XI for Bangladesh Test series

Australia has announced its playing XI for the first Test match against Bangladesh. Key bowlers Pat Cummins and Josh Hazlewood are set to feature in the lineup. The series marks Bangladesh's return to playing in Australia after 23 years, with the first Test scheduled to take place in the Top End. Some analysts suggest the series could be crucial for certain Australian batters.
